title: Glass Vanity Shelf With Integrated Towel Bar, 16-Inch Solid Brass Wall Mount | Waverly Place Collection | Allied Brass
body_html:
Clear counter clutter and keep towels right where you need them with a wall-mounted glass shelf that adds storage at the vanity without taking up surface space.

  • Organize daily essentials with a tempered, beveled-edge glass shelf designed for bathroom use.
  • Keep towels within reach thanks to the integrated towel bar beneath the shelf.
  • Rely on enduring hardware crafted from solid brass materials for secure wall-mount support.
  • Create a coordinated look with the Waverly Place collection for matching Waverly Place accessories and versatile bath accessories.

Specs & Installation

  • Glass dimensions: 16 x 5 inches
  • Glass thickness: 3/8 inch (0.38 in)
  • Projection: 5 inches
  • Weight capacity: 2 lb
  • Mounting: wall mount (installation hardware included)
  • Assembly required: No
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
